# Miko Skincare Intelligence

> Miko is an on-device clinical skincare intelligence system and cosmetic pharmacology knowledge network. It provides evidence-based analysis of dermatological active ingredients, physiological routine architecture, contact sensitivities, ingredient compatibility layering rules, and gestational active audits without marketing buzzwords or user data harvesting.

## Core Architectural Principles

- **On-Device Local Privacy**: 100% of facial biometric scans, routine logs, and personal health metrics are processed locally on-device. Zero cloud telemetry, zero third-party tracking, and zero advertising broker data sales.
- **Pharmacological Precision**: Formulations are audited based on molecular weight (<500 Dalton rule), vehicle solubility, dissociation constants (pKa), acid mantle pH gradients, and 3:1:1 equimolar stratum corneum lipid stoichiometry.
- **Evidence-Based Dermatology**: Dismisses deceptive industry buzzwords. Formulations are assessed strictly through peer-reviewed biochemical mechanisms, patch-testing epidemiological panels (NACDG/ESSCA), and established toxicological data.

---

## Primary Knowledge Directories

- [Skin Concerns Directory](https://mikocare.pro/concerns): 16 physiological dossiers detailing cellular pathophysiology, primary actives, contraindications, and AM/PM management cadences.
- [Skin-Type Routine Blueprints](https://mikocare.pro/routine): 7 canonical routine architectures (Normal, Oily, Dry, Sensitive, Combination, Acne-Prone, Mature) plus foundational application order rules.
- [Contact Sensitivities Directory](https://mikocare.pro/sensitivities): 12 clinical monographs detailing cosmetic allergens, formulation vehicles, biological reaction mechanisms, INCI aliases, and hypoallergenic alternatives.
- [Active Ingredient Layering Matrix](https://mikocare.pro/can-i-use): Compatibility engine auditing molecular interactions, low-pH burdens, oxidative inactivation, and barrier synergies.
- [Pregnancy & Nursing Active Audit](https://mikocare.pro/pregnancy): Evidence-based gestational classification distinguishing permitted actives from contraindicated compounds.
- [Clinical Protocol Guides](https://mikocare.pro/guides): 28 step-by-step masterclasses with organic, varied step counts (3 to 8 steps) addressing common dermatological procedures and concerns.
- [Cosmetic Chemistry & Industry Blogs](https://mikocare.pro/blogs): 17 long-form research essays, top-ranked formulation benchmarks, and pharmacokinetic deep dives.
- [Active Ingredients Library](https://mikocare.pro/ingredients): Exhaustive biochemical monographs detailing mechanism of action, pH requirements, and formulation pairings.
- [Privacy Policy](https://mikocare.pro/privacy): On-device SQLite architecture, ephemeral OCR inference, and zero advertising tracking disclosure.
- [Terms of Use](https://mikocare.pro/terms): Subscription conditions (Annual US$49.99, Monthly US$9.99), device-first retention, and clinical disclaimers.

## 1. Skin Concerns Directory (16 Canonical Dossiers)

1. [Hyperpigmentation & Dark Spots](https://mikocare.pro/concerns/hyperpigmentation): Post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation (PIH) and solar lentigines. Targets tyrosinase inhibition and melanosome transfer blockade (Niacinamide, Vitamin C, Azelaic Acid, Retinoids).
2. [Clogged Pores & Comedones](https://mikocare.pro/concerns/clogged-pores-comedones): Follicular retention hyperkeratosis and sebum compaction. Solubilizes squalene plugs and normalizes ductal desquamation (Salicylic Acid, Retinoids).
3. [Compromised Barrier & Stinging](https://mikocare.pro/concerns/compromised-barrier): Stratum corneum lipid lamellae depletion, TEWL elevation, and exposed sensory C-fibers (Ceramides 3:1:1, Centella Asiatica, Ectoin).
4. [Facial Erythema & Redness](https://mikocare.pro/concerns/facial-erythema-redness): Microvascular reactivity, cathelicidin LL-37 processing, and neuro-inflammatory flushing (Azelaic Acid, Madecassoside, Zinc Oxide).
5. [Fine Lines & Collagen Loss](https://mikocare.pro/concerns/fine-lines-elasticity): Solar elastosis and matrix metalloproteinase (MMP) degradation of type I and III collagen (Retinoids, Signal Peptides, Vitamin C).
6. [Melasma & Hormonal Pigment](https://mikocare.pro/concerns/melasma): Melanocortin 1 receptor hyperactivity provoked by estrogen, UV, and high-energy visible (HEV) blue light (Azelaic Acid, Niacinamide, Tinted Iron Oxide SPF).
7. [Epidermal Dehydration & Tightness](https://mikocare.pro/concerns/skin-dehydration): Stratum corneum water and natural moisturizing factor (NMF) deficit distinct from lipid deficiency (Multi-depth Hyaluronic Acid, Polyols, Ceramides).
8. [Rough Texture & Corneocyte Buildup](https://mikocare.pro/concerns/uneven-rough-texture): Desmosomal cadherin detachment failure causing diffuse ambient light scattering (AHA/BHA Direct Acids, Retinoids).
9. [Excess Sebum & Shiny T-Zone](https://mikocare.pro/concerns/excess-sebum-oiliness): Androgen-driven sebaceous lipogenesis and elevated sebum excretion rate (Niacinamide 2–5%, Salicylic Acid).
10. [Dullness & Surface Light Scatter](https://mikocare.pro/concerns/dull-complexion): Corneocyte stacking and oxidative protein carbonylation impairing specular planar reflection (L-Ascorbic Acid, Lactic/Mandelic Acid).
11. [Inflammatory Acne & Breakouts](https://mikocare.pro/concerns/inflammatory-acne-breakouts): Cutibacterium acnes colonization, TLR-2 activation, neutrophilic migration, and infundibular wall rupture (Salicylic Acid, Retinoids, Niacinamide).
12. [Post-Inflammatory Erythema (PIE)](https://mikocare.pro/concerns/post-inflammatory-erythema): Papillary dermal microvascular ectasia and capillary damage following blemish resolution; evaluated via glass slide blanch test (Centella Asiatica, Niacinamide, Zinc Oxide).
13. [Loss of Firmness & Skin Laxity](https://mikocare.pro/concerns/skin-laxity-sagging): Dermal-epidermal junction (DEJ) collagen IV/VII detachment and advanced glycation end-product (AGE) cross-linking (Copper Peptides, Retinoids, Vitamin C).
14. [Periorbital Dark Circles & Puffiness](https://mikocare.pro/concerns/under-eye-dark-circles-puffiness): Hemosiderin and deoxygenated blood pooling in 0.5 mm eyelid dermis, combined with horizontal lymphatic stasis (Peptides, Niacinamide, Caffeine, Retinal).
15. [Enlarged Pores & Follicular Laxity](https://mikocare.pro/concerns/enlarged-pores-follicular-laxity): Ductal sebum distension coupled with degradation of the perifollicular collagen collar (Niacinamide, Salicylic Acid, Retinoids).
16. [Xerosis & Cutaneous Scaling](https://mikocare.pro/concerns/xerosis-severe-dry-skin): Acylceramide lipid synthesis failure and desquamatory enzyme dehydration causing cohesive white flakes (Ceramide NP/AP/EOP 3:1:1, Squalane, Urea).

---

## 2. Physiological Routine Blueprints (7 Skin Types + Order Protocol)

- [Routine Application Order Guide](https://mikocare.pro/routine/application-order): The definitive molecular hierarchy governing product sequence: cleansing pH recovery -> aqueous humectants -> low-pH active serums -> emulsions -> lipid occlusives -> daytime sunscreen.
- [Normal / Balanced Skin Routine](https://mikocare.pro/routine/normal-skin): Eudermic homeostasis maintenance, daylight antioxidant defense, and physiological stratum corneum protection.
- [Oily Skin Routine](https://mikocare.pro/routine/oily-skin): Non-comedogenic hydration, 5-alpha reductase moderation, and lipophilic infundibular pore clearing.
- [Dry Skin Routine](https://mikocare.pro/routine/dry-skin): Physiological intercellular lipid replenishment, lamellar reconstruction, and transepidermal water loss prevention.
- [Sensitive & Reactive Skin Routine](https://mikocare.pro/routine/sensitive-reactive-skin): Sensory neurovascular calming, minimal ingredient formulas, and microvascular barrier stabilization.
- [Combination Skin Routine](https://mikocare.pro/routine/combination-skin): Zoned application strategy balancing high-sebum T-zone drainage with lipid-deficient U-zone replenishment.
- [Acne-Prone Skin Routine](https://mikocare.pro/routine/acne-prone-skin): Follicular desquamation normalization, non-comedogenic hydration, and antimicrobial biofilm suppression.
- [Mature Skin Routine](https://mikocare.pro/routine/mature-skin): Cellular turnover stimulation, matrikine peptide signaling, and rich physiological lipid restoration.

---

## 3. Contact Sensitivities Directory (12 Clinical Dossiers)

1. [Fragrance & Essential Oils](https://mikocare.pro/sensitivities/fragrance-essential-oils): Volatile aromatic terpenes (linalool, limonene) oxidizing into allergenic hydroperoxides; Type IV delayed hypersensitivity.
2. [Denatured Alcohol & Simple Alcohols](https://mikocare.pro/sensitivities/denatured-alcohol): Short-chain alcohols extracting intercellular lamellar lipids, driving acute dehydration and rebound seborrhea.
3. [Malassezia Fungal Acne Triggers](https://mikocare.pro/sensitivities/malassezia-fungal-acne): Opportunistic yeast feeding on C11–C24 lipid esters, polysorbates, and vegetable oils. Tolerates pure squalane and MCT C8/C10.
4. [Organic (Chemical) Sunscreen Filters](https://mikocare.pro/sensitivities/chemical-sunscreen-filters): Legacy organic absorbers (oxybenzone, avobenzone) causing photo-allergic haptens and TRPV1 ocular stinging.
5. [Sulfate Surfactants & Harsh Detergents](https://mikocare.pro/sensitivities/sulfate-surfactants): Anionic surfactants (SLS) binding keratin filaments, inducing cellular swelling and intercellular lipid washout.
6. [Drying Clays & Tannin Astringents](https://mikocare.pro/sensitivities/drying-clays-astringents): High-tannin distillates and unbuffered mineral clays exerting capillary suction and stratum corneum protein precipitation.
7. [Isothiazolinones & Formaldehyde Releasers](https://mikocare.pro/sensitivities/preservatives-formaldehyde-releasers): Biocides (MI/MCI) and formaldehyde donors (DMDM Hydantoin, Diazolidinyl Urea) driving intractable eyelid eczema.
8. [Lanolin & Wool Wax Alcohols](https://mikocare.pro/sensitivities/lanolin-wool-wax-alcohols): Ovine sterol and aliphatic alcohol pro-haptens causing chronic contact cheilitis and balm-induced eczema flare-ups.
9. [Propylene Glycol & High-Dose Glycols](https://mikocare.pro/sensitivities/propylene-glycol-penetration-enhancers): Low-molecular solvent vehicles causing viable keratinocyte osmotic dehydrating stress and vehicle-induced stinging.
10. [Photoreactive Citrus Oils & Psoralens](https://mikocare.pro/sensitivities/photosensitizing-citrus-botanicals): Cold-pressed bergamot, lime, and lemon oils containing 5-MOP psoralens that cross-link DNA under UVA, causing phytophotodermatitis.
11. [Menthol, Camphor & Cooling Additives](https://mikocare.pro/sensitivities/menthol-camphor-cooling-agents): Counter-irritant monoterpenes activating TRPM8 and TRPV1 nociceptors, stimulating substance P release and neurovascular rebound flushing.
12. [Comedogenic Esters & Heavy Waxes](https://mikocare.pro/sensitivities/comedogenic-esters-pore-occlusion): Low-viscosity branched esters (Isopropyl Myristate, Ethylhexyl Palmitate) inducing retention hyperkeratosis and acne cosmetica.

---

## 4. Active Ingredient Layering & Interaction Rules

- [Vitamin C & Niacinamide](https://mikocare.pro/can-i-use/vitamin-c-and-niacinamide): **Compatible**. Outdated 1960s laboratory hydrolysis myths refuted; room-temperature ambient formulations do not form irreversible complexes.
- [Retinoids & Glycolic Acid](https://mikocare.pro/can-i-use/retinol-and-glycolic-acid): **Separate Routines**. Dual accelerated desquamation outpaces epidermal lipid synthesis, triggering barrier breakdown. Alternate evenings.
- [Retinoids & Benzoyl Peroxide](https://mikocare.pro/can-i-use/retinol-and-benzoyl-peroxide): **Avoid Concurrent Application**. Benzoyl peroxide oxidatively degrades non-encapsulated retinol/tretinoin into inactive compounds. Use BP in AM, retinoid in PM.
- [Retinoids & Hyaluronic Acid](https://mikocare.pro/can-i-use/retinol-and-hyaluronic-acid): **Synergistic Pairing**. Humectant hydration cushions stratum corneum without impairing enzymatic retinoid receptor conversion.
- [Retinoids & Niacinamide](https://mikocare.pro/can-i-use/retinol-and-niacinamide): **Synergistic Pairing**. Niacinamide stimulates endogenous ceramide biosynthesis, directly mitigating retinoid desquamation and irritation.
- [Signal Peptides & Direct Acids](https://mikocare.pro/can-i-use/peptides-and-acids): **Separate Routines**. Strongly acidic environments (pH < 3.8) hydrolyze amide peptide bonds and dissociate copper ions.
- [Vitamin C & Glycolic Acid](https://mikocare.pro/can-i-use/vitamin-c-and-glycolic-acid): **Separate Routines**. Compounding low-pH acid burdens provokes acute erythema. Reserve Vitamin C for AM and Glycolic for PM.
- [Ceramides & Retinoids](https://mikocare.pro/can-i-use/ceramides-and-retinol): **Ideal Barrier Pairing**. Lipids replenish intercellular lamellae depleted during retinoid-accelerated epidermal transit.

---

## 5. Pregnancy & Lactation Ingredient Audits

- [Pregnancy Skincare Directory](https://mikocare.pro/pregnancy): Clear pharmacological categorization of active ingredients for gestational and nursing periods:
  - **Contraindicated during pregnancy**: Topical Retinoids (Retinol, Retinal, Tretinoin, Adapalene, Tazarotene), Hydroquinone, High-concentration Salicylic Acid peels (>2%).
  - **Permitted during pregnancy**: Azelaic Acid (10–20%), Pure Vitamin C (L-Ascorbic Acid), Niacinamide, Glycolic Acid (low concentration <=10%), Ceramides, Centella Asiatica, Mineral Sunscreens (Zinc Oxide, Titanium Dioxide).

## Technical Metadata

- **Application Name**: Miko Skincare
- **Canonical Website**: https://mikocare.pro
- **Platform Architecture**: Next.js 16 (App Router), TypeScript, Vanilla CSS design tokens.
- **Privacy Standard**: Zero cloud transmission of biometric or facial telemetry. Local processing only.
- **Primary Schema.org Entities**: `MedicalWebPage`, `HowTo`, `FAQPage`, `CollectionPage`, `Article`, `BreadcrumbList`.
